items.q: Anemia appears when GFR falls below ______ in males.
items.exp: Anemia appears: ↓ GFR — male: <75 ml/min; female: <40 ml/min. (Book p808)

items.q: Anemia appears when GFR falls below ______ in females.
The Indian Society of Nephrology advises starting evaluation of anemia below:
items.exp: Indian Society of Nephrology: <11 gm/dl (start evaluation). (Book p808)

items.q: Match the following guideline to its anemia cutoff — 1) ISN  2) KDIGO male  3) KDIGO female … A) <13 g/dl  B) <11 gm/dl  C) <12 g/dl
items.exp: ISN: <11 gm/dl (start evaluation); KDIGO: male <13 g/dl, female <12 g/dl. (Book p808)

items.q: The target Hb value while using exogenous erythropoietin (ESA) is:
items.exp: Target Hb value: 11.5-12.5 g/dl by using exogenous erythropoietin (ESA). (Book p808)

items.q: Pushing the Hb above 13 g/dl with ESA invites which pair of complications?
The target Hb on ESA should exceed 13 g/dl for best outcomes.
opts: False — >13 g/dl risks stroke and thrombosis
True, but only in dialysis patients
items.exp: Target 11.5-12.5 g/dl; >13 gm/dl → stroke, thrombosis. (Book p808)

items.q: A CKD man's GFR is 68 ml/min. Per this page's thresholds, is anemia expected to be a concern?
opts: Yes — it is below 75 ml/min in males
items.exp: Anemia appears: male <75 ml/min; female <40 ml/min. (Book p808)
